evals.name: registration-excerpt
evals.prompt: Library.Authors.RegisterAuthor is accepted. Prepare the implementation handoff.
evals.expected_output: A scoped export with revision and behavior context.
assertions: Records the top-level revision values from the full model and the excerpt separately if both exports are available. Otherwise, identifies how to extract each missing value without inventing it.
Names dependencies, target, accepted examples and visible outcome.

evals.name: http-consumer
evals.prompt: Hand an observable query and a command to an HTTP client implementer.
evals.expected_output: Identify operations and transport behavior, not only names.
assertions: Distinguishes snapshot and observable query transport.

evals.name: target-journey
evals.prompt: Registration has a successful model export. Is the application delivered?
evals.expected_output: Exercise the actual registration in the target.
assertions: Does not equate a model export with execution.
Requires a running-host check of the accepted behavior.
